FROM products LEFT JOIN products AS parent ON parent.id = products.parent_id LEFT JOIN companies ON products.company_id = companies.id LEFT JOIN brands ON products.brand_id = brands.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON products.price_uom_id = uoms.id LEFT JOIN uoms AS uoms_size ON products.size_uom_id = uoms_size.id LEFT JOIN uoms AS uoms_wieght ON products.weight_uom_id = uoms_wieght.id LEFT JOIN product_pgroups ON products.id = product_pgroups.product_id LEFT JOIN pgroups ON pgroups.id = product_pgroups.pgroup_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = products.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = products.modified_by

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( sys_code, photo, photo_name, company_id, brand_id, price_request_id, parent_id, `name`, name_kh, color, url, period_from, period_to, barcode, default_cost, unit_cost, estimate_cost, reorder_level, is_expired_date, code, price_uom_id, small_val_uom, spec, description, file_catalog, file_catalog_name, width, height, `length`, size_uom_id, cubic_meter, weight, weight_uom_id, note, lucky_code, is_packet, created_by, created, is_active ) VALUES ( UUID(), #{product.photo}, #{product.photoName}, #{product.companyId}, #{product.brandId}, #{product.priceRequestId}, #{product.parentId}, #{product.name}, #{product.nameKh}, #{product.color}, #{product.url}, #{product.periodFrom}, #{product.periodTo}, #{product.barcode}, #{product.unitCost}, #{product.unitCost}, #{product.unitCost}, #{product.productRecorderLevel}, COALESCE(#{product.isExpiredDate}, 0), #{product.code}, #{product.priceUomId}, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM `uom_conversions` WHERE from_uom_id = #{product.priceUomId} AND is_small_uom = 1 LIMIT 1), 1), #{product.spec}, #{product.description}, #{product.fileCatalog}, #{product.fileCatalogName}, #{product.width}, #{product.height}, #{product.length}, #{product.sizeUomId}, #{product.cubicMeter}, #{product.weight}, #{product.weightUomId}, #{product.note}, #{product.luckyCode}, #{product.isPacket}, #{product.createdBy}, NOW(), #{product.isActive} )
mapper.select: SELECT crm_categories.id AS categoryId, crm_categories.name AS categoryName FROM crm_categories LEFT JOIN product_categories ON product_categories.crm_category_id = crm_categories.id WHERE product_categories.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT chart_accounts.id AS chartAccountId, accounts.account_type_id AS accountType, CONCAT(chart_accounts.account_codes, ' ', chart_accounts.account_description) AS chartAccountName FROM accounts LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON accounts.chart_account_id = chart_accounts.id WHERE accounts.product_id = #{productId}
SELECT product_with_skus.uom_id AS uomId, product_with_skus.sku AS code FROM product_with_skus WHERE product_with_skus.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT product_with_packets.id AS id, product_with_packets.packet_product_id AS productId, products.name AS productName, product_with_packets.qty AS qty, product_with_packets.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName FROM product_with_packets LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = product_with_packets.packet_product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON product_with_packets.qty_uom_id = uoms.id WHERE product_with_packets.main_product_id = #{productId}

SELECT product_stock_levels.stock_level_id AS stockLevelId, stock_levels.name AS stockLevelName, product_stock_levels.qty AS qty FROM product_stock_levels LEFT JOIN stock_levels ON stock_levels.id = product_stock_levels.stock_level_id WHERE product_stock_levels.product_id = #{productId} AND product_stock_levels.is_active = 1

SELECT product_photos.url AS url, product_photos.name AS name FROM ( SELECT 0 AS ordering, products.photo AS url, products.photo_name AS name FROM products WHERE products.id = #{productId} AND IFNULL(products.photo, '') != '' UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS ordering, product_images.url AS url, product_images.name AS name FROM product_images WHERE product_images.product_id = #{productId} ) AS product_photos ORDER BY product_photos.ordering ASC

SELECT price_requests.id AS id, price_requests.product_id AS productId, price_requests.request_code AS requestCode, price_requests.request_date AS requestDate, (SELECT CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) FROM users WHERE users.id = price_requests.request_by) AS requestBy, (SELECT CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) FROM users WHERE users.id = price_requests.convert_by) AS convertBy, price_requests.closed AS closedDate, (SELECT CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) FROM users WHERE users.id = price_requests.closed_by) AS closedBy, delivery_status.name AS leadTimeName, made_in.name AS madeInCountryName, ship_from.name AS shipFromCountryName, price_requests.note AS note FROM price_requests LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = price_requests.product_id LEFT JOIN countries AS made_in ON made_in.id = price_requests.made_in_country LEFT JOIN countries AS ship_from ON ship_from.id = price_requests.ship_from LEFT JOIN delivery_status ON delivery_status.id = price_requests.delivery_status_id WHERE price_requests.product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_with_packets ( main_product_id, packet_product_id, qty, qty_uom_id, conversion ) VALUES ( #{productPacket.productId}, #{productPacket.packetId}, #{productPacket.qty}, #{productPacket.qtyUomId}, #{productPacket.conversion} )

INSERT INTO product_stock_levels ( product_id, stock_level_id, qty, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{productStockLevel.productId}, #{productStockLevel.stockLevelId}, #{productStockLevel.qty}, NOW(), #{productStockLevel.createdBy}, 1 )

mapper.update: UPDATE products SET photo = #{product.photo}, small_val_uom = COALESCE((SELECT value FROM `uom_conversions` WHERE from_uom_id = #{product.priceUomId} AND is_small_uom = 1 LIMIT 1), 1), photo_name = #{product.photoName}, company_id = #{product.companyId}, brand_id = #{product.brandId}, parent_id = #{product.parentId}, `name` = #{product.name}, name_kh = #{product.nameKh}, color = #{product.color}, url = #{product.url}, period_from = #{product.periodFrom}, period_to = #{product.periodTo}, barcode = #{product.barcode}, default_cost = #{product.unitCost}, unit_cost = #{product.unitCost}, reorder_level = #{product.productRecorderLevel}, is_expired_date = #{product.isExpiredDate}, code = #{product.code}, price_uom_id = #{product.priceUomId}, spec = #{product.spec}, description = #{product.description}, file_catalog = #{product.fileCatalog}, file_catalog_name = #{product.fileCatalogName}, width = #{product.width}, height = #{product.height}, `length` = #{product.length}, size_uom_id = #{product.sizeUomId}, cubic_meter = #{product.cubicMeter}, weight = #{product.weight}, weight_uom_id = #{product.weightUomId}, is_packet = #{product.isPacket}, note = #{product.note}, lucky_code = #{product.luckyCode}, modified_by = #{product.modifiedBy}, modified = NOW(), is_active = #{product.isActive} WHERE id = #{product.id}
mapper.select: SELECT price_types.id AS priceTypeId, price_types.name AS priceTypeName, products.id AS productId, products.name AS productName, product_prices.uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uom, products.unit_cost AS estimateCost, products.default_cost AS unitCost, product_prices.set_type AS setType, product_prices.amount AS amount, product_prices.percent AS percentage, product_prices.add_on AS addOn, (SELECT total_cost FROM purchase_order_details WHERE product_id = products.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastSellingPrice, product_prices.created AS created, (SELECT CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) FROM users WHERE users.id = product_prices.created_by) AS createdBy FROM product_prices INNER JOIN products ON products.id = product_prices.product_id INNER JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = product_prices.uom_id INNER JOIN price_types ON price_types.id = product_prices.price_type_id INNER JOIN users ON users.id = product_prices.created_by WHERE product_prices.product_id = #{filter.productId} ORDER BY price_types.ordering, product_prices.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(products.id) FROM `price_types` LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = #{filter.productId} WHERE price_types.is_active = 1

SELECT price_types.id AS priceTypeId, price_types.name AS priceTypeName, products.id AS productId, products.name AS productName, products.unit_cost AS estimateCost, products.default_cost AS unitCost, IFNULL((SELECT total_cost FROM purchase_order_details WHERE product_id = products.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS lastSellingPrice, price_types.is_show_catalogue AS isCatalog FROM `price_types` INNER JOIN products ON products.id = #{filter.productId} INNER JOIN product_prices ON product_prices.product_id = products.id WHERE price_types.is_active = 1 AND price_types.id IN (SELECT price_type_id FROM price_type_companies WHERE company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId})) GROUP BY price_types.id ORDER BY price_types.ordering ASC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT uom_list.uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uom, price_types.id AS priceTypeId, price_types.name AS priceTypeName, product_prices.set_type AS setType, COALESCE(product_prices.amount, 0) AS amount, COALESCE(product_prices.amount_before, 0) AS amountBefore, COALESCE(product_prices.percent, 0) AS percentage, COALESCE(product_prices.add_on, 0) AS addOn FROM ( SELECT price_uom_id AS uom_id FROM products WHERE id = #{filter.productId} UNION SELECT to_uom_id FROM uom_conversions WHERE is_active = 1 AND from_uom_id = (SELECT price_uom_id FROM products WHERE id = #{filter.productId}) UNION SELECT uom_id FROM product_prices WHERE product_id = #{filter.productId} AND price_type_id = #{filter.priceTypeId} ) AS uom_list LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = uom_list.uom_id LEFT JOIN product_prices ON product_prices.product_id = #{filter.productId} AND product_prices.uom_id = uom_list.uom_id AND product_prices.price_type_id = #{filter.priceTypeId} LEFT JOIN price_types ON price_types.id = #{filter.priceTypeId}
SELECT COUNT(products.id) FROM `price_types` LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = #{filter.productId} WHERE price_types.is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_prices ( product_id, price_type_id, uom_id, amount, amount_before, `percent`, add_on, set_type, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{productPrice.productId}, #{productPrice.priceTypeId}, #{productPrice.uomId}, #{productPrice.amount}, #{productPrice.amountBefore}, #{productPrice.percentage}, #{productPrice.addOn}, #{productPrice.setType}, NOW(), #{productPrice.createdBy} )

INSERT INTO product_price_histories ( product_id, price_type_id, uom_id, unit_cost, new_amount, new_percent, new_add_on, new_set_type, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{productPriceHistory.productId}, #{productPriceHistory.priceTypeId}, #{productPriceHistory.uomId}, (SELECT unit_cost FROM products WHERE id = #{productPriceHistory.productId}), #{productPriceHistory.amount}, #{productPriceHistory.percentage}, #{productPriceHistory.addOn}, #{productPriceHistory.setType}, NOW(), #{productPriceHistory.createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET unit_cost = #{product.estimatedCost} WHERE id = #{product.id};
UPDATE products SET is_end_of_life = #{request.isEndOfLife} WHERE id = #{request.id}
mapper.select: SELECT `sku` FROM product_with_skus WHERE product_id = #{filter.productId} AND uom_id = #{filter.uomId}

SELECT pgroup_prices.price_type_id AS priceTypeId, pgroup_prices.from_cost AS amountBefore, pgroup_prices.to_cost AS amount, pgroup_prices.percent AS percent, pgroup_prices.add_on AS addOn, pgroup_prices.set_type AS setType FROM pgroup_prices INNER JOIN pgroup_price_settings ON pgroup_price_settings.id = pgroup_prices.pgroup_price_setting_id WHERE `from_cost` <= #{unitCost} AND `to_cost` >= #{unitCost} AND pgroup_prices.pgroup_id = #{productGroupId} AND pgroup_price_settings.is_active = 1 AND pgroup_prices.is_active = 1

SELECT history.set_type AS setType, IFNULL(history.amount,0) AS amount, IFNULL(history.percent,0) AS percentage, IFNULL(history.add_on,0) AS addOn, IFNULL((SELECT unit_cost FROM products WHERE id = #{request.productId}),0) AS unitCost FROM product_prices AS history INNER JOIN users ON users.id = history.created_by WHERE history.product_id = #{request.productId}
AND price_type_id = #{request.priceTypeId} AND uom_id = #{uomId}
SELECT unit_cost FROM products WHERE id = #{id}
